paite: Kongkhak ngak pawl khendan: Kore mi bel Asaph tapate lak a Kore tapa Meshelemiah ahi.
heading: Tempul Vengtute

paite: Huan Meshelemiah in tapate anei a: ata masa Zekariah ahi a, azom Jediael, athumna Zebadiah, alina Jathniel;
angana Elam, agukna Jehohanan, asagihna Elioenai ahi.
Obed-edom in tapate anei a; ata masa Shemaiah ahi a, azom Jehozabad, athumna Joah, alina Sakar, angana Nethaneel,
agukna Amiel, asagihna Issakar, agiatna Peulethai ahi, amah bel Pathian in avualzawl hi.
Atapa Shemaiah a kipan tapa, a-inkote uh vaihawmte leng apiang ua; amaute mihat hangsan ahi chiat uhi.
Shemaiah tapate Othni, Rephael, Obed leh Elzabadte ahi ua, a-unau uh Elihu leh Semakiah bel mihat mahmah ahi uh.
Huaite tengteng Obed-edom suante ahi ua: amau leh atapate uh leh a-unaute uh nasepna lamsang ah mi piching ahi uh; Obed-edom a kipan mite sawmguk-le-nih ahi uhi.
Meshelemiah in tapa leh unau mihat mahmah sawm-le-giat anei hi.
Merari suante lak a Hosah in leng tapate anei a; Shimri bel amakai lianpen ahi a, ta masa ahi kei na a, apa'n makaipen in abawl hi.
Azom in Hilkiah ahi a, athumna Tebaliah, alina Zekariah ahi. Hosah tapate leh a-unaute avek un sawm-le-thum ahi uh.
Huai amakaipente lak a mi a-unaute uh bang a TOUPA' inn a nasem thilbawl a tantuan nei a kongkhak ngakmi pawl a akhente uh ahi.
Aneu alian in, a-inkuan dungzui zel un kongpi chih a om ding zonna ding in ai asan uhi.
Huchi in suahlam a dia aisan pen Shelemiah tung ah atu hi. Lemgel siam piltak, atapa Zekariah a ding in ai asan ua, mallam pen amah a tuam in atu hi.
Simlam bel Obed-edom tuam in; atapate tuam in Asuppim.
Tumlam a toupaina lampi a Shaleketh kongkhak venna toh, Shuppim leh Hosah tuam in.
Suahlam ah Levite guk a-om ua, niteng in mallam ah li, simlam ah li, thil koihkhawmna inn ah nih tuaktuak.
Tumlam inn um sung a ding in alutna ah li; inn um sung ah nih.
Huaite ahi uh, Korah tapate leh Merari mi tapate kongkhak ngakmi pawl akhente uh.
Huan a-unaute uh Levite lak ah Ahijah, Pathian sum koihkhawmna inn leh thil latsate koihkhawmna inn heutu ahi.
heading: Sumkemte Leh Ulian Dangte

paite: Laadan tapate: Gershon mite tapate Laadante a te, pipute inkote amakai lianpen Gershon mi Laadan a te; Jehieli.
Jehieli tapate: Zetham, Joel a-unaupa, TOUPA' inn a sum koihkhawmna heutu ahi uh.
Amram mite a kipan, Izhar mite a kipan, Hebron mite a kipan, Uzziel mite a kipan:
Mosi tapa, Gershom tapa Shebuel sum koihkhawmna heutu ahi.
A-unaute bel Eliezer tapa Rahabiah, Jeshaiah, Joram, Zikri leh Shelomithte ahi.

Shelomith leh a-unaute bel kumpipa David leh a-inkote uh makaipen sepaih sangkhat heutute leh zakhat heutute leh sepaih pawl heutute'n ahihsiangthousa uh, thil siangthou koihkhawmna inn tengteng kemte ahi uhi.
Kidouna gallak thilte TOUPA' inn bawlphatna ding in akoih uhi.
Zawlnei Samuel, Kish tapa Saul, Ner tapa Abner leh Zeruiah tapa Joabte'n ahihsiangthou tengteng uh, kuapeuh in thil ahihsiangthousa peuhmah uh Shelomith leh a-unaute kep vek ahi.
Izhar mi Kenaniah leh atapate Israel gam polam tungtang thu a heutute leh vaihawmmi ahi uh.
heading: Levi Dangte Nasep

paite: Hebron mi Hashabiah leh a-unau mihangsan sangkhat-le-zasagih Jordan gal tumlam a Israelte ukpate ahi uhi; TOUPA nna tengteng leh kumpipa nasepna lam nna ah.
Hebron mi Jerijah bel asuan uh tungtang thu a inko makai lam ah Hebronte, amakaipente ahi uhi. David kum sawmli avaihawm kum a azon un Gilead gam a Jazer ah mihat hangsan amukhia uhi.

A-unau mihangsante sangnih-le-zasagih ahi uhi. Huaite inko makaipen, kumpipa David in Pathian lam thil chiteng leh kumpipa na lam thu a Reuben, Gad leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte heutu dia abawlte ahi uh.
